name: Agendize
description_en:
Agendize is an enterprise appointment and customer-interaction platform for networks of locations and advisers. It documents centrally governed booking rules, routing by staff attributes, calendar integration and customer follow-up, rather than only a personal scheduling link.

The current French pricing page starts with an enterprise pack and a minimum licence commitment. Hosted, dedicated and on-premises configurations have distinct technical and commercial requirements.
description_zh:
Agendize 是面向多地点、顾问网络的企业预约与客户互动平台，文档列有集中预约规则、按员工属性分配、日历集成与客户跟进，不仅是个人排程链接。

当前法语定价页从企业套餐及最低许可承诺起步。共享托管、专用与本地部署有不同技术和商业要求。

core_features.explanation_en: Route appointments using adviser/location attributes and business rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按顾问／地点属性和业务规则分配预约。

core_features.explanation_en: Inspect status/history and reassign or reschedule through the console.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过控制台检查状态／历史，重新分配或改期。

core_features.explanation_en: REST/webhooks and account-specific authentication support system integration.
core_features.explanation_zh: REST／webhook 与账户相关认证支持系统集成。

en: Route qualified client appointments across branches.
zh: 跨网点分配合适的客户预约。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Shared SaaS, dedicated or on-premises options; commercial/configuration scope differs.
Deployment.zh: 共享 SaaS、专用或本地部署选项；商业／配置范围不同。

steps.en: Map locations, services, routing rules and delegated roles for a small pilot.
steps.zh: 为小型试点明确地点、服务、分配规则与委派角色。

steps.en: Configure a widget/link and inspect rescheduling/cancellation history with test records.
steps.zh: 配置组件／链接，使用测试记录检查改期／取消历史。

steps.en: Confirm minimum licences, hosting and integration authorisation before rollout.
steps.zh: 推广前确认最低许可、托管与集成授权。

items.en: Developer documentation distinguishes partner multi-account SSO-token/API-key access from OAuth2 for one account. An active account/developer console and, for partner tokens, support access are prerequisites. Token renewal and client-secret handling matter for integrations; a successful request is not proof that every downstream booking or CRM update completed. Agendize suits governed multi-site routing; a solo scheduler may not need its ten-seat commitment. No deployment, API call, security certification audit or recovery test was performed; open-source licensing was not established.
items.zh: 开发者文档区分合作伙伴多账户 SSO token／API key 与单账户 OAuth2。需要有效账户／开发者控制台，合作伙伴 token 还需支持方开放权限。集成需处理 token 更新和 client secret；一次请求成功不证明所有下游预约或 CRM 更新完成。Agendize 适合有治理要求的多地点分配；个人排程可能不需要十席承诺。未执行部署、API 调用、安全认证审计或恢复测试，也未确认开源许可。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual user licences, minimum ten; add-on/usage charges possible.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Entreprise from €25/user/month excluding tax, billed annually, ten licences minimum. Premium quote; trial duration unknown; SMS credits separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Entreprise 起价每用户每月 25 欧元未税，按年收费，最低十许可。Premium 询价；试用时长未知；短信额度另计。

sections.title_en: Route a client to the right adviser
sections.title_zh: 把客户分配给合适顾问
sections.en: For an illustrative branch network, configure locations, services, adviser skills/languages and calendars, then expose a contextual booking link or embedded widget. The platform describes automatic routing by availability, location and competence, with manual acceptance or automatic validation. A working pilot should include an unavailable adviser and a client reschedule, not only the easiest open slot. Central and delegated permissions need to match the actual organisation.
sections.zh: 例如网点网络可配置地点、服务、顾问技能／语言及日历，再提供带上下文的预约链接或嵌入组件。平台说明可按可用时间、地点和能力自动分配，并支持人工接受或自动确认。试点应包含顾问不可用和客户改期，而不只验证最容易的空时段。集中与委派权限应符合实际组织。

sections.title_en: A paid marker is not a captured payment
sections.title_zh: 已付标记不等于实际扣款
sections.en: The console guide shows day/week/month/list views, with drag-and-drop only in day/week. Appointment details expose status and history, and allow reassignment or duration changes. Clicking a paid marker records payment status; do not infer that it processed a charge. The same guide warns cancellation cannot be undone and describes a free mode that bypasses configured constraints. Restrict that mode and inspect history when diagnosing a scheduling conflict.
sections.zh: 控制台指南提供日／周／月／列表视图，只有日／周支持拖放。预约详情显示状态和历史，允许重新分配或改变时长。点击“已付”记录付款状态，不能推断已处理扣款。指南还提示取消无法撤销，并说明可绕过配置约束的自由模式。建议限制此模式，排查冲突时检查历史。

sections.title_en: Minimum seats, annual billing and SMS credits
sections.title_zh: 最低席位、年度账单与短信额度
sections.en: Entreprise is advertised from €25 excluding tax per user/month, billed annually, with ten licences minimum. At that advertised floor, ten licences imply €3,000/year before tax and extras; this is arithmetic, not a final quote. Premium is custom. SMS requires prepaid credits, and dedicated/on-premises hosting or custom integrations can be optional. A try-now button does not establish a perpetual free tier, trial duration or card policy. Confirm the signed pack and usage charges.
sections.zh: Entreprise 宣传起价每用户每月 25 欧元未税，按年收费，至少十许可。按此宣传下限，十许可折算每年 3,000 欧元未税及附加费；这是计算，不是最终报价。Premium 询价。短信需预购额度，专用／本地托管和定制集成可能另选。“立即试用”按钮不能证明有永久免费档、试用时长或信用卡规则。需确认签订套餐及用量费用。

research_gaps.en: Trial conditions, exact pack entitlements, signed hosting/SLA, live integrations and recovery were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实试用条件、确切套餐权益、签订的托管／SLA、真实集成和恢复。
